Location: Tangguh + Jakarta
Description:

A Marine Manager is sought for a major international logistics company involved in a significant LNG project in Indonesia. The role requires leading marine operations, overseeing vessel selection and compliance, and coordinating activities between various stakeholders. Responsibilities include managing cargo operations, port activities, and developing operational procedures. Candidates need over 15 years of marine operations experience in Oil & Gas, with at least 10 years in a senior leadership position, and strong knowledge of maritime regulations and safety. Experience with LCT, MPV, project cargo, or offshore marine operations is highly beneficial.

Description:

A Handover Lead position is available for a major Oil & Gas (LNG) project in Qatar.
